- [What is a posterior predictive check and why is it useful?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yDPJnV9vcHs) — Ben Lambert, English. Xem posterior predictive check, dùng cho bước lab không dừng sau khi chuỗi đã hội tụ.
